stimuli.title: Amina’s Home Plan
stimuli.description: A new room list written for this test.

stimuli.title: Mariam’s Home
stimuli.text: Mariam lives in a big home. Her home has three bedrooms. The kitchen has four chairs. A green armchair is in the living room. The family’s garden has three trees and some flowers. Their car is in the garage.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Identify rooms for household items
questions.prompt: Where is the oven in Amina’s home plan?
questions.evidence: Amina’s Home Plan lists the oven in the kitchen.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Find two items in a room list
questions.prompt: Which pair of items is listed in Amina’s living room?
questions.evidence: The living-room row lists a sofa and an armchair.
options: a) a sofa and an armchair
b) a sink and a tub
c) an oven and three chairs

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Find a quantity in a room inventory
questions.prompt: How many lamps are listed in Amina’s living room?
questions.evidence: Amina’s Home Plan lists two lamps in the living room.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Use there are with plural nouns
questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly describes the kitchen entry.
questions.evidence: “Three chairs” is plural, so the sentence uses “There are three chairs in Amina’s kitchen.”
options: a) There are three chairs in Amina’s kitchen.
b) There is three chairs in Amina’s kitchen.
c) There are three chair in Amina’s kitchen.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Make a negative statement about a room
questions.prompt: Amina’s home plan says there is no television in the bedroom. Which sentence matches the plan?
questions.evidence: The plan says there is no television in the bedroom; use “There isn’t” for one missing item.
options: a) There isn’t a television in the bedroom.
b) There aren’t a television in the bedroom.
c) There is a television in the bedroom.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Form a yes-or-no question about one household item
questions.prompt: Amina wants to ask if her bathroom has one sink. Which question has the correct word order?
questions.evidence: For a singular item, the question begins “Is there …?”: “Is there a sink in Amina’s bathroom?”
options: a) Are there a sink in Amina’s bathroom?
b) Is there a sink in Amina’s bathroom?
c) Is there sinks in Amina’s bathroom?

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Find a location in a new home description
questions.prompt: Where are the flowers in Mariam’s home description?
questions.evidence: The passage says the family’s garden has flowers.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Find furniture in a new home description
questions.prompt: Which item is named in Mariam’s living room?
questions.evidence: The passage says a green armchair is in the living room.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Read a quantity in a new home description
questions.prompt: How many bedrooms does Mariam’s home have?
questions.evidence: The passage says Mariam’s home has three bedrooms.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Check a statement against a new home description
questions.prompt: True or False: Mariam’s family keeps its car in the living room.
questions.evidence: The passage places the car in the garage, not the living room.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Recall a quantity from a home description
questions.prompt: How many trees are in the family’s garden?
questions.evidence: The passage says the garden has three trees.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Write a sentence with there is and a singular room item
questions.prompt: Write one complete sentence using these notes: Leen’s bedroom / one desk.
questions.correct: There is one desk in Leen’s bedroom
accepted: there is one desk in leen’s bedroom
there is one desk in leens bedroom
questions.wrongSample: There are one desk in Leen’s bedroom
questions.evidence: “One desk” is singular, so the sentence uses “There is”: “There is one desk in Leen’s bedroom.”
